Sūrah Al - Qāricah And Sūrah At-
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used because it is the seat of all his thoughts."
The heart is used because it is the seat of all his thoughts.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are a flexible arrangement between you and your tutorial facilitator."
Tutorial sessions are a flexible arrangement between you and your tutorial facilitator.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the one which draws him to his Lord while the clay glues him to the earth."
The spirit is the one which draws him to his Lord while the clay glues him to the earth.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the elevating path through which upright human nature ascends to its ultimate perfection."
Faith is the elevating path through which upright human nature ascends to its ultimate perfection.
fib: ______ is a flexible arrangement between you and your tutorial facilitator.
Time of facilitation is a flexible arrangement between you and your tutorial facilitator.
______ is the crux of the matter; that is the reason for the oath.
The fourth verse is the crux of the matter; that is the reason for the oath.
______ are the roots of his misfortunes, and not the period or place…An illustration of this is corruption which has eaten deep into the fabrics of our polity, religion, economy, etc.
The deeds of man are the roots of his misfortunes, and not the period or place…An illustration of this is corruption which has eaten deep into the fabrics of our polity, religion, economy, etc.
